architecture.shell: Windows x64 executable contains UI/backend shell only; no textbook payload.
architecture.content: Six-book verified replaceable ZIP; 6 books / 253 reader documents / 29,076 content files.
architecture.updates: Content ZIP can be installed and hot-switched without rebuilding EXE; managed package is content-addressed and atomically activated.
architecture.personal_state: Notes/bookmarks/cards/reading positions/user font remain outside the content package.

reading_experience.fullscreen: F11/button -> Fullscreen API; immersive fallback; native monitor-level Windows acceptance still pending.
reading_experience.immersive: M / Esc; reading chrome hidden with recovery HUD.
reading_experience.typography: Windows local ShuSong-first stack; regular body weight 400; font-synthesis none; commercial font files are not redistributed.
reading_experience.clean_reading: Source/OCR/provenance interruptions hidden from normal flow but retained in reversible audit layer.
reading_experience.mode_flow: Preview scaffold -> continuous Learn -> active-recall Review -> Practice with folded per-question answers and persistent drafts.

final_pagination_fixes: Source table/figure caption and matching media are grouped as one pagination unit so captions do not strand at page bottoms.
Grouped source media is indivisible at caption/media boundaries and proportionally fit when taller than the A4 body.
Very long multi-formula source records split first on semantic child/formula blocks, then character-level only inside a child.

validation.default_a4: 253/253 PASS; text mismatch 0, overflow 0, overlap 0, blank pages 0, true heading/caption orphan 0, JavaScript errors 0.
validation.extreme_a4: 24/24 representative largest documents PASS at 72px / line-height 2.6 / 30mm margins; text loss/overflow/overlap/blank pages 0; 15 oversized source media/formula objects were automatically fit without overflow.
validation.print_path: 4/4 PASS; Chromium printed PDF page count matched A4 sheets and every page had readable text.
validation.managed_install: PASS: final 411,840,379-byte package whole-file + per-file verification and atomic activation; observed ~7s in local isolated test.
validation.windows_static: PASS: MZ/PE, x86-64, PE32+ GUI, exact shell payload embedded, textbook content not embedded.
validation.drive_readback: PASS: EXE and seven content parts re-downloaded, per-file SHA-256 matched; parts reconstructed to the exact whole content SHA-256; ZIP CRC PASS.

content_invariance.step5_changes: Reader shell pagination/build/test logic only; content package files remain the authoritative Step3/Step4 content bytes aside from final package metadata identity.

boundaries: This environment cannot execute the Windows binary on a real Windows desktop. Native Windows F11/monitor fullscreen, DPI scaling, actual installed ShuSong rasterization, and OS print-dialog acceptance remain pending.
Chromium Fullscreen API wiring, immersive mode, ShuSong-first CSS policy, A4 pagination and Chromium PDF print path are verified.
No commercial ShuSong font binary is redistributed.
